description: Arithmetic on the published rates: per-job checks and/or the commission for a given order value. Returns line items, the commission band, payment timing and exclusions. An estimate, not a quotation; travel beyond 100 km of Jinhua is flagged rather than priced.

basic_factory_audits.description: Number of basic factory audits (one day on site each).

beyond_100km_of_jinhua.description: True if the factory is more than 100 km from Jinhua, Zhejiang (for example in Guangdong).

extra_audit_man_days.description: Additional audit man-days beyond the basic scope.

inspection_man_days.description: Inspection man-days. One SKU with standard sampling is typically one man-day; three SKUs on one order is one to two.

order_value_usd.description: Order value in USD, for the full-engagement commission.

name: estimate_fees
title: Estimate fees from published rates
